scientific_question: Can one real-text-pretrained model sequentially acquire relational binding (x2), two-hop in-context composition, and inverse retrieval while retaining earlier capabilities and real-text competence, with adaptive capability-specific protection more efficient than permanent rehearsal?

substrate.model: Ark018GPT (10 blocks, width 384, 6 heads, vocab 8192, context 256, tied head)

dose_stage_b.selection_rule: smallest candidate passing both parent pilots

phase_seed_binding: B/C/D seeds bound into arm and checkpoint identity; each phase streams only with its own seed

controller_rules.replay_allocation: risk-based lowest robust-min first, deterministic tiebreak, max 2 slots/update, replaces real-text only
controller_rules.static_rotation: deterministic round-robin over old qualified capabilities
controller_rules.predictive_trigger: robust_min < 0.95 OR degradation <= -0.03/100 over last 3 CONTROL observations
controller_rules.cap_calibration: per matched set, 16x median full-delta over 32 LOW-LR shadow steps

metrics_policy.acquisition_rule: per phase: median guardian phase-relative confirmation <= 1.5 x median PLASTIC_HIGH phase-relative confirmation, medians across matched sets
metrics_policy.prevention: never formally unqualified during later phases

verdict_rules.formation_gate: PLASTIC_HIGH qualifies each new skill in >= 3/4 sets else INCONCLUSIVE_FORMATION_INSTABILITY_PHASE_X
verdict_rules.interference_gate: plastic sets with >=1 old-capability CONTROL failure >= 2/4 OR static_1of32 area advantage >= 0.15 else INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_INTERFERENCE

durability.exact_resume_smoke: PRODUCTION exact_resume_smoke executed in tests and as a campaign gate; 12 independently hashed state classes: model, optimizer, scaler, cpu_rng, cuda_rng, registry, controller, counters, phase_identity (all three phase seeds), confirmations, telemetry, semantic_stream
durability.lock: CAMPAIGN_LOCK.json (experiment, executable commit, session uuid, timestamp, host); ACTIVE/STALE/MALFORMED; ACTIVE never silently overridden
durability.resume_scan: cell 0 mounts Drive BEFORE scan; verifies schema/version/seeds/arm/task_hash/parent_hash/dose against ENTRY_RECEIPT and DOSE_SELECTION; PARTIAL_IDENTITY_CHECK where unverifiable; SAFE ACTION in {START NEW CAMPAIGN, RESUME, WAIT — ACTIVE WRITER LOCK EXISTS, STOP — CHECKPOINT IDENTITY FAILURE, STOP — CAMPAIGN VERSION MISMATCH, STOP — DRIVE UNAVAILABLE}

claim_ceiling: controlled real-text-proxy evidence for a multi-capability continual-learning controller candidate; two-hop composition and inverse retrieval are proxies, never 'reasoning demonstrated'; no PRE500M/500M, no AGI or consciousness claims
